runs.name: thinning-fraction-0.1-to-1.0
runs.notes: The budget drawn as a share of what the reconstructor predicted rather than as a count of Gaussians, on the best base the runs so far have found: 150k on the card, twelve context views, output heads left as the checkpoint has them. Every run tonight slid along the same frontier, winning the sparse budgets and losing the dense ones or the reverse, because a count that this card can hold is a tenth of the prediction at twelve views and the whole of it at two, so a run only ever trains at one end of the thinning. Drawing the share instead covers the whole of it at every view count, which is what validation asks for at 250k and 500k.
